nom: CNP Laboratory Propolis Deepcerin Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: This deep cleansing bomb worked great. I like to rub it all over my face while I am wearing makeup and let it sit for a minute or two. And then I get in the shower, rinse it off, and apply my favorite facial cleanser to get all the residue off. Works.

I was pleasantly surprised at how cleansing this balm was! Having never used a product with this consistency, I worried that the creamy texture would feel heavy. Upon applying, it melts into the skin, and after rinsing, it leaves no residue. Used this after a day of wearing sunscreen with makeup and running errands, came home to cleanse and felt very refreshed! One star removed because while I do like the scent and am not typically bothered by scented products, it's a bit strong and I could see it being overpowering to someone with a sensitivity. For a product like this, the scent feels a bit mismatched.

Works very very well. Super gentle on the skin, didn't cause any irritation. We've been moving and things have been hectic, this was a nice soothing little me time and the balm being so soth and gentle made it very easy to help relax.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this again
avis.texte: This balm is is very smooth. I love the smooth, buttery texture and how it just melts into my skin when I apply it. The packaging is another bonus: you can just twist the cap to get the amount you need, no digging your fingers in. It's pretty helpful at removing makeup, but unfortunately doesn't remove all of it. It still requires some cleansing afterwards to remove what's left. But I love how moisturizing it feels without being oily, and I would absolutely recommend it. I received this product for free in exchange for leaving a review.
This product was great, it had a very smooth feeling which was perfect because I dislike the watery creams! It did a good job cleansing as well!

This is one of the best cleansing balms I've tried. I've started using it at the end of the day to remove my makeup, and it works so well. It feels like it's melting into your skin, and I don't even need to use a lot to get rid of even my waterproof makeup. It doesn't really have a strong smell in my opinion, which I prefer, and it leaves my skin feeling nice and hydrated instead of dry, like other cleansers I've tried in the past. Highly recommend you try this as your next cleanser.

Thank you CNP Laboratory for the free cleansing bomb! The packaging on this cleansing balm is so well thought out—since it's a twist design, you'll never accidentally use too much at once, which I love. I use this every night after my makeup remover and before my face wash, and I've definitely noticed a difference. My skin feels incredibly clean and smooth after using it. Highly recommend!

I use this cleanser to take off my makeup after a long day. I find that this product was able to take off my makeup and not strip my skin. After each use I was felt with my face feeling moisturized and cleanse. I love this product on my dry skin.

I actually was pleasantly surprised. First thing hat catches the eye is the dispenser: it definitely has some wow-factor in the way it dispenses. It sort of 'slices' the product out when you rotate it. Works well, dispenses evenly and as much product as you need, and very higyenic (huge plus for me!). You can't see how much product is left though, but it comes with most dispensers as of my experience. Regarding the cleansing itself - works great. Not too oily, light enough, cleanses well and leaves my skin soft and silky. Has a nice fragrance too. It indeed turned out better than I expected.

avis.titre: Gentle, Effective Cleanser That Leaves Skin Soft and Balance
avis.texte: I have tried quite a few cleansing balms over the years, so I was excited to try this Propolis Deepcerin Cleansing Balm. After using it consistently for a while, it has honestly become one of my favorite first step cleansers in my skincare routine. The first thing that stood out to me was the packaging. Instead of having to scoop product out of a jar with a spatula, the container has a twist up design that dispenses the balm. It makes the whole process feel cleaner and more convenient, and I really like not having to deal with messy jars. The texture is smooth and buttery, and it melts quickly when massaged onto dry skin. I typically wear sunscreen, foundation, and sometimes waterproof mascara, and this balm breaks everything down very easily. Once I add a little water, it turns into a milky texture that rinses off without leaving a heavy or greasy feeling behind. Another thing I really appreciate is how nourishing it feels while cleansing. My skin feels clean but not stripped or tight afterward. Instead, it feels soft, hydrated, and comfortable, which is something I always look for in a cleansing balm. I also found it to be very gentle around my eyes. Some cleansers can sting or irritate when removing eye makeup, but this one removes everything without any discomfort. After using it regularly, my skin feels smoother and more balanced, and it does a great job removing makeup, sunscreen, and daily buildup. Overall, I would definitely recommend the Propolis Deepcerin Cleansing

This is my first time trying a cleansing balm and I am obsessed. I first use this to remove my makeup and then go in with another cleanser to make sure everything comes off. I do really like the smell and I would definitely recommend/ repurchase.

This is my first time trying a cleansing balm. I love how thick it is, soooo hydrating! The packaging is super nice, I love the way the product comes out! There is a very light scent but it is pleasant and not overwhelming. My skin feels amazing after using this, definitely recommend! I received this product free for testing purposes.

I absolutely love this makeup remover cleanser! It removes all my makeup so easily, even waterproof mascara, without leaving my skin feeling dry or tight. My face feels clean, soft, and refreshed every time I use it. It's gentle on my skin and perfect for everyday use. Definitely a must-have in my skincare routine!

This balm is great for a thorough double cleanse. Makeup melts off so easily, and the balm is easy to rinse. I follow up with a foaming cleaner and my skin feels so clean afterwards, leaving a great base for my other nighttime products. Recommend!
I really like this cleanser! It's not at all irritating like some other cleansing balms can be.

This balm is FANTASTIC! I had honestly never used one before, and now? I can never go back. I wear sunscreen every single day, and it can sometimes cause my skin to breakout, even when I cleanse, just because I can't cleanse deeply enough to really remove the impurities. First, the container is so much fun. Twisting the top while the product spins out. I had eye makeup and multiple coats of mascara, used only this balm to remove it, and it left nothing behind! It saved so much time, and saved my eyelashes from getting pulled out. My entire face feels so supple and smooth, I just get excited to use it each day!

avis.titre: A Gentle Yet Effective Cleansing Balm
avis.texte: I've been using the Propolis Deep Cerin Cleansing Balm to remove my makeup and I'm really impressed. It melts down quickly into an oil and easily breaks down foundation, mascara, and sunscreen without me having to scrub. My skin feels clean but still soft and hydrated after rinsing, not tight or stripped. It's been a great first step in my double cleanse routine.

I love the component the balm comes in, super easy to use. The balm smelled amazing, fragrance not super strong. The balm suds up very nicely to remove all the make up I had on my face. It did an amazing job. Would recommend and buy again.

Sometimes cleansing balms feel oily after using and this stuff makes your skin feel CLEAN. Not even a tight, dry clean either. A moisturized clean feeling. The bottle is also very clever but I do feel like the instructions on the website are much better than the instructions of the container.

Amazing cleansing balm that melts easily into the skin and removes makeup, sunscreen, and impurities without harsh rubbing. It rinses off cleanly and leaves my skin feeling soft, hydrated, and not stripped. Perfect as a gentle first step in a double-cleansing routine.

avis.titre: Love it more than my luxe cleansing balm
avis.texte: I've previously used a much more expensive cleansing balm and have found this one to be better at removing makeup and a nice, soft honey scent. It's definitely a nice addition to my skincare routine.
I was very impressed by this cleansing balm. It did a great job of taking off my make-up and cleaning my face, while not feeling too drying. The smell was also nice!

avis.titre: The best cleansing balm on the market
avis.texte: I've tried so many cleansing balms and haven't had luck finding one that made my skin feel clean and nourished without irritation until now! This cleansing balm removes all my makeup and SPF, and leaves my skin feeling so nice. I follow with a regular gel cleanser and my face feels so clean. I absolutely would repurchase and recommend this product.

I love the packaging of this deepcerin cleansing balm. I just twist the cap and i get the perfect amount of balm i need to cleanse my face. It doesn't strip my skin at all. My skin feels so soft and clean after use. If I use light makeup, I don't even need to double cleanse. It takes up all my makeup, even mascara and my face feels so soft and smooth. I love how my face feels every time I use this

This cleaner was amazing! It took off all my makeup so nicely! I didn't have to scrub super hard to get my mascara off either which I greatly appreciate. I will definitely be buying more of this once I run out!!!

I recently tried Propolis Cleansing Balm and they made a new costumer out of me! The packaging is sleek and well-designed, which makes it feel a bit more luxurious right from the start. The applicator is amazing—super easy to use and definitely a huge plus for me because it keeps things mess-free and convenient. The balm itself smells fantastic, not overpowering but just enough to make the experience enjoyable. I didn't need to use a large amount to cover my face, which makes the product feel like it will last a while. I attached a picture of how much product I actually applied. After rinsing, my skin didn't feel dry at all; in fact, it felt soft and moisturized, which is a huge plus since so many cleansers can leave my skin tight. It removed my makeup easily and I didn't have to reapply to get it all off! Overall, this cleansing balm is effective, pleasant to use, and gentle on the skin—I'd definitely recommend it.

avis.titre: So effective and sensitive skin friendly!
avis.texte: I was extremely impressed by this product. It was able to dissolve my waterproof mascara and even my lip-stain with ease! I love how hygienic it is dispersing only a little bit of product at a time. The scent was light but reminded me of honey. I highly recommend this

I received a sample an exchange for a review. I love the packaging of this cleanser, it's efficient and great for travel. This cleanser also did a good job removing my mascara and was not drying. I also like that there's no overwhelming scent in this cleanser.

I received this product for free in exchange for a review! Overall, I like this balm pretty alright! I love that the package is twist up, so you don't waste any product and it keeps everything sanitary. The balm is light and feels good on my skin, and once rinsed off, my face is extremely soft. It has a nice smell to it, too, almost citrusy but fresh at the same time. It was also helpful in removing stubborn makeup remnants! My only issue is that this product unfortunately made me breakout a bit. Otherwise, this balm was great!

I love this cleansing balm ! The grinder is perfect for distributing the perfect amount of product while keeping everything clean and relatively hygienic. There is a slight scent but nothing overbearing. I would absolutely recommend this !

avis.titre: Gentle, Effective and Perfect for Everyday Cleansing ✨
avis.texte: I really like this cleansing balm 🫶🏼The texture is thick at first,but it melts into an oil as soon as it touches the skin.It removes makeup and SPF really well,even waterproof mascara comes off without rubbing.After rinsing,my skin feels soft and clean,not tight or greasy.The only small downside is that it has a light herbal scent that might not be for everyone,but it fades quickly and doesn't irritate my skin.

avis.titre: I highly recommend this cleansing balm
avis.texte: I highly recommend this cleansing balm! It effortlessly melts away makeup, even stubborn mascara, without any harsh rubbing. It feels incredibly gentle and soothing on the skin, leaving my face clean, soft, and hydrated instead of stripped. It's become a staple in my routine, and I love how easy and effective it is. Definitely a must-have for removing makeup while keeping your skin happy!
Smells nice, not too overpowering. Goes on well, is smooth. Cleaned up my makeup and face. Felt moisturizing on skin. Didn't breakout my face. Will keep using and would buy again!

I love using this product to remove makeup. Doesn't dry out your skin but removes makeup so well. I can't emphasize enough how genius this packaging is!!! I won't ever go back to another cleansing balm.

CNP Laboratory kindly gave me this Propolis Deepcerin Cleansing Balm for free so that I could review it. I find this to be an extremely sensorial 1st step cleanse. It easily removes my waterproof makeup and spf without irritating my face. The packaging also is so convenient to get just the right amount of product you need without a spatula or using your hands. My face feels visibly softer too.
Really the most innovative packaging I have ever seen for a product like this! It leaves me feeling clean and buildup-free!

I was graciously gifted this Deepcerin Cleansing Balm by Propolis through my participation with the product testing website BzzAgent. I received this product from Propolis for free and I am so glad that I got to try it because I love it. The product smells lovely. It also leaves an invigorating tingle while it works on my face that makes my face feel refreshed. My face feels so much cleaner after using this and the pleasant smell makes it fun to use. I also loved the design of the packaging where the balm comes out as you turn the packing lid almost like sharpening a pencil. I love that I am able to control how much product I shave out of the packaging. The container was very easy to use and the way it is dispensed makes it less messy to work with. I love this balm and will continue to use it. I 10/10 recommend this product; especially with its innovative packaging and how clean it makes my skin feel.

The texture is light and silky, weightless. It glides on smoothly and gently removes all types of makeup (mascara, foundation, eyeliner, lipstick). After rinsing, there's no tightness; skin feels very soft.

First of all I really love the packaging. The bottle and way of dispensing the product is super unique and like nothing ive used before. After the first use I noticed my skin was way more moisturized than usual. Being in Michigan winter my skin is naturally dry so this might be my new winter staple.

avis.titre: Non comedogenic and sanitary! I love it.
avis.texte: When I received this product to try out, I was excited because I love Korean skincare. However, this was far better than I even thought it was going to be. The packaging was easy and sanitary with a scraper that dispenses product (love). Most cleansing balms break me out but this one was very gentle on my skin and did not clog my pores at all while removing my makeup pretty well. If you're thinking about purchasing this product, it is a good one!

Its a very effective cleaning balm. It easily removes my makeup without adding any pimples to my skin. Its gentle around the eye area and doesn't smell too strong. I highly recommend it for those with sensitive skin

Not a fan of the product. The container is cool and I like how the cleaner is dispensed, but I don't like the product. The scent is SO strong and smells of a lemon cleaning product. I could smell it on my face after cleansing again with a different cleanser. It did not take my makeup off at all. There are a lot better products I'd try before this one.

If you're looking for a cleansing balm that actually *performs*, let me put you on to the Propolis Deepcerin Cleansing Balm. From the very first use of the full-size product, I was impressed. It melted my makeup off effortlessly. Foundation, mascara, long-wear products… it broke everything down so smoothly without me having to tug at my skin. My face felt genuinely clean afterward, but not stripped or tight. Another thing I appreciated was the scent. It doesn't have an overpowering or unpleasant smell, which is a big deal for me. It feels gentle, effective, and luxe all at the same time. And let's talk about the packaging because this was an unexpected bonus. The twist-up dispenser is such a smart design. You twist to release the product, so there's no messy scooping, no product spilling everywhere, and no wasting it around the lid. It keeps everything clean and controlled, which I absolutely love. Honestly, after trying it, I didn't need convincing. It's one of those products that makes you immediately think, "Okay, this is staying in my routine." If you're on the fence about trying it, go for it. It's definitely worth the buy. Clean skin, easy application, no mess, and makeup gone in seconds. That's a win.

avis.titre: I would definitely purchase this again!
avis.texte: I recently tried this product out, and have been using it for a little while now, and I would definitely recommend it, as I've had a great experience since using. I find this product to work very effectively at cleansing the face, and my face feels smooth, clean, and revitalized after use. It has a nice refreshing, natural scent to it as well that I appreciate. I also really love the container it comes in, you turn it and it dispenses enough product so that you don't overuse or have to dig it out, which I love. I would definitely recommend!

avis.titre: I love the way it cleans my skin
avis.texte: I was using it a couple times already. And I really like it. It cleans my makeup really good and makes my skin moist and soft.

avis.titre: This is the best product I have ever used.
avis.texte: I love, love this product. It is to clean your face and at the same time taking off all of your makeup. It reminds me of shaved butter as I massage it into my face. You then use warm water to rinse it off. When I woke up the next morning after using it for the first time I touched my face and it felt like satin it was so smooth and soft. I will definitely be buying this product from now on!

I got this about a week ago and love it. It's a deep cleansing balm that removes all my makeup and grim from the day easily. Feels good don't break me out very easy to fit into your every day routine. Plus it has the fancy packaging that twist up the perfect amount like it shaves it off the top. I received this product for free for from bzzz test and review purposes.

avis.titre: Smells heavenly and melts like cloud
avis.texte: This is mess free as you don't need to scoop it out. It is so soft and melts instantly dissolving makeup along the process. It left my skin hydrated and bright and I'm in love with this smell.

This is a fantastic cleansing balm. It takes off a full face of makeup, doesn't leave a residue or film behind, and has a light fresh smell that isn't too strong. I appreciate the unique dispenser, but it's a bit hard to gauge how much you need the first few times you use it because it basically thingy shaves the product and I couldn't quite tell how much product it was. Once you get the hang of it, it's great. Highly recommend.
